items.question: Is Ijen health screening mandatory?
items.answer: A pre-hike health screening is included in your package and is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry (supported by BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024). It is conducted at your hotel before the guide briefing.

items.question: What does the screening typically check?
items.answer: Typical checks include basic measurements such as blood pressure and oxygen level plus a short set of questions by trained medical staff, following local guidelines.

items.question: What happens if someone is not cleared?
items.answer: If a guest is denied clearance, affected components may not operate for that person. Policy handling follows /policy/booking-payment-cancellation.

items.question: Does screening guarantee nothing will happen?
items.answer: No. Screening reduces risk but conditions remain subject to local authority decisions, weather/visibility, and on-site safety assessments.

items.question: How is screening-related data handled?
items.answer: If personal data is collected during screening, it is handled in line with JVTO privacy commitments and provider/authority requirements. See /policy/privacy.
